sqlite.sessions: SELECT id AS id, working_dir AS cwd, description AS title, parent_session_id AS parent_id, CASE WHEN CAST(created_at AS TEXT) GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 WHEN CAST(created_at AS INTEGER) > 10000000000 THEN CAST(created_at AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(created_at AS INTEGER) * 1000 END AS started_at, CASE WHEN CAST(updated_at AS TEXT) GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN CAST(strftime('%s', updated_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 WHEN CAST(updated_at AS INTEGER) > 10000000000 THEN CAST(updated_at AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(updated_at AS INTEGER) * 1000 END AS ended_at FROM sessions
sqlite.text: SELECT m.role AS role, group_concat(json_extract(b.value, '$.text'), char(10)) AS text FROM messages m, json_each(COALESCE(m.content_json, '[]')) b WHERE m.session_id = ?1 AND json_extract(b.value, '$.type') = 'text' GROUP BY m.id, m.role ORDER BY m.id
